issue.title: just install / install-dev / install-venv: three honest install commands
issue.description: `just install` installs the latest sase release from PyPI as the user's `sase` command, `just install-dev` installs this checkout plus its pin-paired sase-core (editable) in exactly the shape `sase update` maintains, and today's venv recipes live on as `just install-venv*`. Every consumer is migrated: CI, the tool catalog, runtime remedies, docs, memory, sase-core strings, the plugin repos, and the chezmoi `acei`/`aceii` installers.
